notes.title: Legend of the Outlaw Mage's Bonus Content DLC Now Availalble!
notes.content:
Get a behind-the-scenes look at the art and development for [i]The Legend of the Outlaw Mage[/i] in this interactive art book!

Check it out here:  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913260/Legend_of_the_Outlaw_Mage_Bonus_Content]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913260/Legend_of_the_Outlaw_Mage_Bonus_Content[/url]

Once you download the DLC, launch the main game and you'll be prompted by Steam to load the game or the Bonus Content.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41863017/8359b20854c33ac98a66b2b783e6df83fb5b1133.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.6.20
notes.content:
